# Backward Linear Regression

```{r linreg}
############################################################
# 0) Packages
############################################################
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)

############################################################
# 1) CONFIG — edit these to match your CSV column names
############################################################

cfg <- list(
  # ID columns (optional)
  sale_id_col   = "sale_id",  parcel_col    = "parcel_number",
  # Market / sale price and date
  price_col     = "saleprice",     # numeric
  date_col      = "saledate",      # date or parseable string
  # Size vars
  floorarea_col = "sresb_floorarea",  # sqft living area (numeric)
  lot_col       = "stotalsqft",       # lot sqft (numeric)
  # Example structural predictors (edit to your set)
  beds_col      = "bedrooms",  fullbaths_col = "fullbaths",  halfbaths_col = "halfbaths",
  yearbuilt_col = "yearbuilt",
  # Example categorical predictors
  style_col     = "sresb_style",  condition_col = "condition",  arterial_col  = "arterial",
  # Time adjustment setup
  # Define a month index "months" relative to a base year-month
  base_year     = 2022,  base_month    = 1,
  # 3-bracket breakpoints (example): 1–9, 10–16, 17–24 (cumulative slope basis)
  b1 = 9,  b2 = 16,
  # Optional: if you already have fixed time rates you want to apply
  # If NULL, we'll estimate rates from a time model.
  rate1_fixed = NULL,  rate2_fixed = NULL,  rate3_fixed = NULL,
  # Choose the target "end month" for time adjustment
  # (e.g., last month in sample)
  end_month_mode = "max"  # "max" or numeric month index
)

############################################################
# 2) Import CSV
############################################################

df_raw <- read_csv("sales.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()  # optional but recommended

############################################################
# 3) Basic transforms: ln_price, sppsf, ln_sppsf, baths, etc.
############################################################

df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    saleprice      = .data[[cfg$price_col]],    saledate       = .data[[cfg$date_col]],
    floorarea      = .data[[cfg$floorarea_col]],    lotsqft        = .data[[cfg$lot_col]],
    bedrooms       = if (cfg$beds_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$beds_col]] else NA_real_,
    fullbaths      = if (cfg$fullbaths_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$fullbaths_col]] else NA_real_,
    halfbaths      = if (cfg$halfbaths_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$halfbaths_col]] else NA_real_,
    yearbuilt      = if (cfg$yearbuilt_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$yearbuilt_col]] else NA_real_,
    numbaths       = if_else(!is.na(fullbaths) & !is.na(halfbaths),
                             fullbaths + 0.5 * halfbaths, NA_real_),
    sppsf          = saleprice / floorarea, ln_price  = log(saleprice),   ln_sppsf = log(sppsf)
  )
# parse date robustly
df <- df %>%
  mutate(saledate = as.Date(saledate),  sale_year = year(saledate), sale_month = month(saledate))

############################################################
# 4) Create MONTHS index and 3-piece time bracket variables
############################################################

# month index from base year-month (1-based)
df <- df %>% mutate(months = (sale_year - cfg$base_year) * 12 + (sale_month - cfg$base_month) + 1L)

# 3-bracket cumulative slope basis:
# months_1to9 = min(months, b1)
# months_10to16 = min(max(months-b1,0), b2-b1)
# months_17to24 = max(months-b2,0)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    months_1to9   = pmin(months, cfg$b1),
    months_10to16 = pmin(pmax(months - cfg$b1, 0), cfg$b2 - cfg$b1),
    months_17to24 = pmax(months - cfg$b2, 0)
  )

############################################################
# 5) Estimate time rates (RATE1/2/3) if not provided
############################################################

get_b <- function(mod, nm) {
  b <- stats::coef(mod)[nm]
  base::unname(b)
}

get_time_rates <- function(mod, terms = c("months_1to9","months_10to16","months_17to24")) {
  b <- vapply(terms, function(t) get_b(mod, t), numeric(1))
  missing <- terms[is.na(b)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing time term(s) in model: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  rates <- exp(b) - 1
  names(rates) <- c("rate1","rate2","rate3")
  list(b = b, rates = rates)
}

# Fit a "time-only" model to estimate rates (optionally include some basic controls)
# This is a framework — add controls if you want (size, style, etc.)
if (is.null(cfg$rate1_fixed) || is.null(cfg$rate2_fixed) || is.null(cfg$rate3_fixed)) {
  df_time <- df %>%
    select(ln_price, months_1to9, months_10to16, months_17to24, floorarea, lotsqft) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na()

  mod_time <- lm(
    ln_price ~ months_1to9 + months_10to16 + months_17to24 + log(floorarea) + log(lotsqft),
    data = df_time
  )
  tr <- get_time_rates(mod_time)
  rate1 <- tr$rates["rate1"]
  rate2 <- tr$rates["rate2"]
  rate3 <- tr$rates["rate3"]
} else {
  rate1 <- cfg$rate1_fixed
  rate2 <- cfg$rate2_fixed
  rate3 <- cfg$rate3_fixed
}

############################################################
# 6) Compute PRICE_INDEX, END_INDEX, TAF, TASP
############################################################
# choose end month index
end_m <- if (identical(cfg$end_month_mode, "max")) {
  max(df$months, na.rm = TRUE)} else {as.integer(cfg$end_month_mode)
}
# derive end-month bracket exponents
end_1 <- min(end_m, cfg$b1)
end_2 <- min(max(end_m - cfg$b1, 0), cfg$b2 - cfg$b1)
end_3 <- max(end_m - cfg$b2, 0)
end_index <- (1 + rate1)^end_1 * (1 + rate2)^end_2 * (1 + rate3)^end_3

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    price_index = (1 + rate1)^months_1to9 * (1 + rate2)^months_10to16 *
                  (1 + rate3)^months_17to24,
    taf  = end_index / price_index,  tasp = saleprice * taf,
    ln_tasp = log(tasp),  tasppsf = tasp / floorarea
  )

############################################################
# 7) Run a linear regression (example: LN_TASP model)
############################################################
# Example predictor set — adjust to your project
df_model <- df %>%
  mutate(
    style = if (cfg$style_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$style_col]]) else NULL,
    condition = if (cfg$condition_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$condition_col]]) else NULL,
    arterial = if (cfg$arterial_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$arterial_col]]) else NULL
  ) %>%
  select(
    tasp, ln_tasp, saleprice, floorarea, lotsqft, bedrooms, numbaths, yearbuilt,
    style, condition, arterial
  ) %>% tidyr::drop_na()

mod_ln_tasp <- lm(
  ln_tasp ~ log(floorarea) + log(lotsqft) + bedrooms + numbaths + yearbuilt +
    style + condition + arterial,  data = df_model
)
summary(mod_ln_tasp)

############################################################
# 8) Back-transform predictions to dollars (ESP)
############################################################

df_model <- df_model %>%
  mutate(
    pred_ln = predict(mod_ln_tasp, newdata = df_model), esp = exp(pred_ln), # predicted TASP dollars
    ratio   = esp / tasp       # assessed/sale-style ratio (predicted / actual)
  )

############################################################
# 9) PRD, COD, PRB + supporting stats
############################################################
# COD: 100 * mean(|r - median(r)|) / median(r)
cod <- function(r) {
  r <- r[is.finite(r)]
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  100 * mean(abs(r - med), na.rm = TRUE) / med
}
# PRD: mean ratio / weighted mean ratio
prd <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  mean_r <- mean(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  wmean_r <- sum(p, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(a, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_r / wmean_r
}

# PRB: regress % deviation from median ratio on log(value proxy)
# value proxy often (pred+actual)/2
prb <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  dev_pct <- (r - med) / med * 100
  vproxy <- (p + a) / 2
  x <- log(vproxy) - mean(log(vproxy), na.rm = TRUE)
  coef(lm(dev_pct ~ x))[["x"]] / 100
}

assess_stats <- df_model %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),  median_ratio = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ratio   = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ratio  = sum(esp, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(tasp, na.rm = TRUE),
    prd = prd(esp, tasp), cod = cod(ratio), prb = prb(esp, tasp)
  )

assess_stats
```

# Generalized Additive Models (GAM)

```{r gam}
############################################################
# 0) Packages
############################################################
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(mgcv)

############################################################
# 1) CONFIG — edit to match your CSV
############################################################
cfg <- list(
  price_col     = "saleprice",  date_col      = "saledate",  floorarea_col = "sresb_floorarea",
  lot_col       = "stotalsqft",  beds_col      = "bedrooms",  fullbaths_col = "fullbaths",
  halfbaths_col = "halfbaths",  yearbuilt_col = "yearbuilt",  style_col     = "sresb_style",
  condition_col = "condition",  arterial_col  = "arterial",  base_year  = 2022,
  base_month = 1,  b1 = 9, b2 = 16,             # 3 time brackets: 1–9, 10–16, 17+
  rate1_fixed = NULL,  rate2_fixed = NULL,  rate3_fixed = NULL,
  end_month_mode = "max"       # "max" or numeric month index
)
############################################################
# 2) Import
############################################################
df_raw <- read_csv("sales.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%  janitor::clean_names()
############################################################
# 3) Transforms
############################################################
df <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    saleprice = .data[[cfg$price_col]],  saledate  = as.Date(.data[[cfg$date_col]]),
    floorarea = .data[[cfg$floorarea_col]],  lotsqft   = .data[[cfg$lot_col]],
    bedrooms  = if (cfg$beds_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$beds_col]] else NA_real_,
    fullbaths = if (cfg$fullbaths_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$fullbaths_col]] else NA_real_,
    halfbaths = if (cfg$halfbaths_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$halfbaths_col]] else NA_real_,
    yearbuilt = if (cfg$yearbuilt_col %in% names(.)) .data[[cfg$yearbuilt_col]] else NA_real_,
    numbaths = if_else(!is.na(fullbaths) & !is.na(halfbaths), fullbaths + 0.5 * halfbaths, NA_real_),
    sppsf    = saleprice / floorarea, ln_price = log(saleprice), ln_sppsf = log(sppsf),
    sale_year  = year(saledate),  sale_month = month(saledate),
    months = (sale_year - cfg$base_year) * 12 + (sale_month - cfg$base_month) + 1L,
    months_1to9   = pmin(months, cfg$b1),
    months_10to16 = pmin(pmax(months - cfg$b1, 0), cfg$b2 - cfg$b1),
    months_17to24 = pmax(months - cfg$b2, 0),
    style     = if (cfg$style_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$style_col]]) else NA,
    condition = if (cfg$condition_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$condition_col]]) else NA,
    arterial  = if (cfg$arterial_col %in% names(.)) factor(.data[[cfg$arterial_col]]) else NA
  )
############################################################
# 4) Time rates (RATE1/2/3) — estimate if not fixed
############################################################
get_b <- function(mod, nm) {
  b <- stats::coef(mod)[nm]         # NA if missing
  base::unname(b)
}

get_time_rates <- function(mod, terms = c("months_1to9","months_10to16","months_17to24")) {
  b <- vapply(terms, function(t) get_b(mod, t), numeric(1))
  missing <- terms[is.na(b)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing time term(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  rates <- exp(b) - 1
  names(rates) <- c("rate1","rate2","rate3")
  rates
}

if (is.null(cfg$rate1_fixed) || is.null(cfg$rate2_fixed) || is.null(cfg$rate3_fixed)) {
  df_time <- df %>%
    select(ln_price, months_1to9, months_10to16, months_17to24, floorarea, lotsqft) %>% drop_na()
  # still a simple linear time model to get rates (consistent with your current approach)
  mod_time <- lm(
    ln_price ~ months_1to9 + months_10to16 + months_17to24 + log(floorarea) + log(lotsqft),
    data = df_time
  )
  rates <- get_time_rates(mod_time)
  rate1 <- rates["rate1"]; rate2 <- rates["rate2"]; rate3 <- rates["rate3"]
} else {
  rate1 <- cfg$rate1_fixed
  rate2 <- cfg$rate2_fixed
  rate3 <- cfg$rate3_fixed
}
############################################################
# 5) Compute price_index, end_index, TAF, TASP
############################################################
end_m <- if (identical(cfg$end_month_mode, "max")) max(df$months, na.rm = TRUE) else as.integer(cfg$end_month_mode)
end_1 <- min(end_m, cfg$b1)
end_2 <- min(max(end_m - cfg$b1, 0), cfg$b2 - cfg$b1)
end_3 <- max(end_m - cfg$b2, 0)
end_index <- (1 + rate1)^end_1 * (1 + rate2)^end_2 * (1 + rate3)^end_3

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    price_index = (1 + rate1)^months_1to9 * (1 + rate2)^months_10to16 * (1 + rate3)^months_17to24,
    taf   = end_index / price_index,    tasp  = saleprice * taf,
    ln_tasp = log(tasp),    tasppsf = tasp / floorarea
  )
############################################################
# 6) Non-linear model: GAM for LN_TASP
############################################################
df_model <- df %>%
  select(ln_tasp, tasp, floorarea, lotsqft, bedrooms, numbaths, yearbuilt,
         style, condition, arterial, months) %>% drop_na()
# GAM: smooths for continuous vars; factors as parametric
mod_gam <- mgcv::gam(
  ln_tasp ~
    s(log(floorarea), k = 10) + s(log(lotsqft), k = 10) + s(yearbuilt, k = 10) +
    s(months,         k = 10) +  # optional: lets GAM capture leftover time patterns
    s(numbaths,       k = 6) +  s(bedrooms, k = 6) + style + condition + arterial,
  data = df_model,  method = "REML"
)
summary(mod_gam)
mgcv::gam.check(mod_gam)
############################################################
# 7) Predict + back-transform to dollars
############################################################
df_model <- df_model %>%
  mutate(
    pred_ln = predict(mod_gam, newdata = df_model, type = "link"),
    esp     = exp(pred_ln),     # predicted TASP dollars
    ratio   = esp / tasp
  )
############################################################
# 8) PRD / COD / PRB
############################################################
cod <- function(r) {
  r <- r[is.finite(r)]
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  100 * mean(abs(r - med), na.rm = TRUE) / med
}

prd <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  mean_r <- mean(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  wmean_r <- sum(p, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(a, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_r / wmean_r
}

prb <- function(pred, actual) {
  ok <- is.finite(pred) & is.finite(actual) & actual > 0
  p <- pred[ok]; a <- actual[ok]
  r <- p / a
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  dev_pct <- (r - med) / med * 100
  vproxy <- (p + a) / 2
  x <- log(vproxy) - mean(log(vproxy), na.rm = TRUE)
  coef(lm(dev_pct ~ x))[["x"]] / 100
}

assess_stats <- df_model %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),  median_ratio = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ratio   = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ratio  = sum(esp, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(tasp, na.rm = TRUE),
    prd = prd(esp, tasp),  cod = cod(ratio), prb = prb(esp, tasp)
  )

assess_stats
```

# Gradient Boosting (xgboost)

```{r xgb}
library(xgboost)
# Use the same df_model created above but include only predictors you want
df_xgb <- df %>%
  select(ln_tasp, tasp, floorarea, lotsqft, bedrooms, numbaths, yearbuilt,
         style, condition, arterial, months) %>% drop_na()
# One-hot encode factors
X <- model.matrix(
  ln_tasp ~ log(floorarea) + log(lotsqft) + bedrooms + numbaths + yearbuilt + months +
    style + condition + arterial, data = df_xgb
)
y <- df_xgb$ln_tasp
# Train/test split (quick)
set.seed(1)
idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X)), size = floor(0.8 * nrow(X)))
X_tr <- X[idx, , drop = FALSE]; y_tr <- y[idx]
X_te <- X[-idx, , drop = FALSE]; y_te <- y[-idx]
dtr <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_tr, label = y_tr)
dte <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_te, label = y_te)

params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",  eta = 0.05,  max_depth = 6,
  subsample = 0.8,  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

mod_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = params,  data = dtr,  nrounds = 2000,  watchlist = list(train = dtr, test = dte),
  early_stopping_rounds = 50,  verbose = 0
)
# Predict back on full df_xgb (or just test)
pred_ln <- predict(mod_xgb, newdata = xgb.DMatrix(X))
df_xgb <- df_xgb %>%  mutate(pred_ln = pred_ln, esp = exp(pred_ln), ratio = esp / tasp)

assess_stats_xgb <- df_xgb %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(), median_ratio = median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ratio   = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    wmean_ratio  = sum(esp, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(tasp, na.rm = TRUE),
    prd = prd(esp, tasp), cod = cod(ratio), prb = prb(esp, tasp)
  )

assess_stats_xgb
```

# Geographically Weighted Regression

```{r gwr_alone}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(GWmodel) # Geographically-Weighted Models

# Example: df has lon/lat (WGS84). If you already have projected x/y, skip to gwr.
df_sf <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(26917)   # NAD83 / UTM zone 17N (Detroit-ish). Use the CRS you prefer.

# Example model formula on log scale (recommended for price)
form_gwr <- ln_tasp ~ log(sresb_floorarea) + ln_landratio + ln_base_bldgsize_ratio +
  arterial + fireplace + ln_garagespaces

# Adaptive bandwidth is often best when sales density varies across the city
bw <- GWmodel::bw.gwr(
  form_gwr,
  data = df_sf,
  approach = "CV",
  kernel = "bisquare",
  adaptive = TRUE
)

gwr_fit <- GWmodel::gwr.basic(
  form_gwr,
  data = df_sf,
  bw = bw,
  kernel = "bisquare",
  adaptive = TRUE
)

names(gwr_fit$SDF)

sdf <- gwr_fit$SDF
# If it's sf already, this works; if it's Spatial*, wrap with st_as_sf(sdf)
if (!inherits(sdf, "sf")) sdf <- sf::st_as_sf(sdf)

# Find likely fitted column
cand <- intersect(c("yhat", "pred", "predicted"), names(sdf))
stopifnot(length(cand) == 1)
pred_col <- cand[1]

df_gwr <- df %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(
    sdf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
      select(row_id, gwr_pred_ln = all_of(pred_col)),
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gwr_pred_tasp = exp(gwr_pred_ln)
  )
```

```{r gwr_hybrid}
# 1) global model (example: lm or gam) predicts ln_tasp
df_sf$pred_ln_global <- predict(mod_global, newdata = df_sf, type = "link")
df_sf$resid_ln <- df_sf$ln_tasp - df_sf$pred_ln_global

# 2) GWR on residuals (often just an intercept is enough)
form_resid <- resid_ln ~ 1

bw_resid <- GWmodel::bw.gwr(form_resid, data = df_sf, approach = "CV",
                            kernel = "bisquare", adaptive = TRUE)

gwr_resid <- GWmodel::gwr.basic(form_resid, data = df_sf, bw = bw_resid,
                                kernel = "bisquare", adaptive = TRUE)

sdf_r <- gwr_resid$SDF
if (!inherits(sdf_r, "sf")) sdf_r <- sf::st_as_sf(sdf_r)
cand <- intersect(c("yhat", "pred", "predicted"), names(sdf_r))
pred_col <- cand[1]

df_sf$pred_ln_corrected <- df_sf$pred_ln_global + sdf_r[[pred_col]]
df_sf$pred_tasp_corrected <- exp(df_sf$pred_ln_corrected)
```
